summary: Online PvP on the unmodified reference engine with all authority in Neon: private rooms and a casual queue with transactional admission, authenticated read/command/replay/history/leaderboard routes, seat-safe projections, a full-card board UI with every mandatory choice, version polling, idempotent commands, persisted R26 deadlines (owner-approved algorithm), reconnect, concede, one result per match and casual-only Elo (owner decision; ranked stays disabled). Two real browsers finished a persisted casual match (version 59; Bea won 18-0; ratings 1000->1016 and 1000->984 applied once); duplicates applied once, stale commands got 409, reload restored state, and a leak check against states rebuilt from Neon found no hidden information in either browser's responses. Two defects found in observation were fixed: a poller that stopped in embedded tabs, and 401 instead of 503 when Neon Auth is unreachable.
